name: Cargo sparse registry
auth: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission.
fresh_home: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.
prerequisites: An existing crate with Cargo.toml and source files; an existing consumer naming its dependency with registry = "weave".

configure.code:
export CARGO_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
umask 077
cat > "$CARGO_HOME/config.toml" <<EOF
[registry]
global-credential-providers = ["cargo:token"]
[registries.weave]
index = "sparse+${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/cargo/${AW_REPO}/index/"
EOF
export CARGO_REGISTRIES_WEAVE_TOKEN="Basic $(printf '%s:%s' "$AW_USER" "$AW_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
configure.note: The sparse+ prefix and trailing slash are required. Cargo sends the configured token as the complete Authorization header.

publish.note: Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

steps.note: Use your producer crate path. Acceptance uses a controlled crate with no build dependencies; remove --no-verify for release verification.

install.note: Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

steps.note: For example: hello_cargo = { version = "1.0.0", registry = "weave" } in the consumer dependencies.

limitations: Virtual repositories are not registered for Cargo. No command is offered for V.
For a clean replay, use a new CARGO_HOME and recreate only the configuration above; do not copy the registry/git caches.

contains: A Basic user name must name the token's subject
